name: Hans
tagline: Rules of evidence for minds heard only through a model: accredit the translator against planted ventriloquists, ask whales by offering quiet, and make 'we can't hear them' the applicant's problem.
summary: Hans is a nonprofit accreditor and guardianship for testimony from minds heard only through models, starting with sperm whale clans. A translation pipeline may testify only after passing blind proficiency tests under ISO/IEC 17043, both on species whose semantics are already known and on a rotating secret set of planted ventriloquists, models fine-tuned to produce a desired translation. Each clan gets a guardian whatever the size of its lexicon. The guardian argues from accredited testimony and from randomised relief trials, in which voluntary vessel slowdowns are assigned by day and read through passive moorings linked to AIS, following the child-testimony rule of never leading the witness. When testimony comes back 'unknown', the burden of proof moves to the applicant. The same accreditation applies to AI welfare self-report tools.
core_loop: A party commissions a 'what the whales say' translation -> the pipeline must first pass accreditation on known-answer species (vervet alarms, Japanese tit syntax, dolphin signature whistles) and a secret rotating set of planted ventriloquists -> the clan's guardian poses policy questions as non-leading conditions: randomised voluntary slowdowns by day, never playback of the harm, and only the clan's own recorded codas -> coda and behaviour readouts from passive moorings linked to AIS give yes/no answers with known error rates -> attested entries weight the evidence but never standing -> 'unknown' testimony moves the burden onto the permit applicant -> the guardian files in ISA, NOAA and IMO proceedings -> the same proficiency regime accredits AI welfare self-report tools.
why_now: TMC's Clarion-Clipperton mining application was published in August 2026, with a permit expected in Q1 2027, so motivated 'whale translations' are about to be commissioned by both sides. Bioacoustic ML has arrived: CETI's coda phonetic alphabet, Earth Species Project's NatureLM-audio, Google's DolphinGemma and the $10M Coller Dolittle Prize. Rights-of-nature law (Te Awa Tupua, the 2024 He Whakaputanga Moana declaration of whale personhood) offers a guardianship model. Anthropic, DeepMind and Meta formally study AI welfare, and Eleos has shown that self-reports bend toward what users expect.
mvp: Days 1-30: build proficiency benchmark v0 from public known-answer corpora (vervet alarm calls, Japanese tit syntax, dolphin signature whistles), plus five public planted-ventriloquist models and a secret held-out plant set. Days 31-60: score four existing pipelines (NatureLM-audio, DolphinGemma and CETI-style coda models among them) and publish the accreditation report. Days 61-90: preregister a Dominica randomised slowdown protocol with passive moorings and AIS, apply for ISA observer status, and comment on TMC's NOAA permit. Gate: the benchmark separates planted ventriloquists from honest pipelines at AUC >= 0.9, and at least one pipeline blindly recovers the vervet alarm classes.
stack: Known-answer bioacoustic corpora; planted-ventriloquist models fine-tuned to target translations; secret rotating plant sets run under ISO/IEC 17043 proficiency-testing rules; CETI-style coda detectors and NatureLM-audio; SoundTrap passive acoustic moorings; AIS vessel tracking; randomised voluntary slowdown assignment in the style of Vancouver's ECHO program; OSF preregistration.
business_model: A nonprofit accreditor funded by accreditation fees from pipeline labs, contracts with regulators (ISA, NOAA, IMO, national marine agencies), and philanthropy (Coller Foundation, Bezos Earth Fund). The durable revenue comes from accrediting AI labs' welfare self-report tools against the same planted ventriloquists.
risks: Legal standing for clans and a burden shift on 'unknown' testimony must be won in forums that have never granted either
The attested lexicon may stay tiny for a decade, leaving the guardian to argue mostly from revealed preference
Pipelines may learn to detect planted ventriloquists; mitigated by a secret, rotating, offline plant set
Industry may welcome 'unknown' as no objection unless the precautionary burden shift is adopted
Playback contaminating a socially learned culture; limited to the clan's own codas under a per-clan budget
Relief trials depend on voluntary shipping cooperation, and CCZ clans are far from the Dominica validation site
Accreditation could be captured by whichever funders pay the fees
moonshot: By 2036 an Office of Non-Human Testimony sits beside the ISA and IMO. Clan guardians hold standing in permit proceedings across the Pacific, and their relief trials set seasonal quiet corridors. The first attested two-way exchange happens under the non-leading rule, so nobody can say we put the words in. AI labs' welfare claims, for and against, are heard under the same rules of evidence as a sperm whale's.
best_line: When testimony comes back 'unknown', the burden moves to the applicant: a party that can't yet speak still changes who must prove what.
